name: Grav MCP
description: Private MCP companion for a Grav 2.0 site with the Grav API plugin installed and enabled. The current custom-store Grav package is 2.2.25. Its preserved site data may require migration before reuse. The MCP HTTP transport has no built-in client authentication, so keep this endpoint on a trusted private network.
author: getgrav

form_fields.label: Grav API URL
form_fields.hint: Grav 2.0 API URL, usually ending in /api.
